messages:
nina: Heads-up: planning a dialed rollout for maelstrom-14b-q1 tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. Main goals: avoid token-cost regressions and preserve streaming latency.

High-level plan:
- prewarm KV + prefix cache 20m before in us/eu; skip ap-south for first pass
- staged traffic: 0.5% -> 3% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100% (manual hold between 15->60)
- fallback order: maelstrom-14b-q0 (compat float) -> zephyr-6b-v3 for short sync calls (<=64 tokens) -> emergency sentinel-7b fallback if both saturate
- pinning: hard-pin compat variant for 2h to flatten initial client traffic, then convert to soft-pin for 4h

Rollback/guardrails:
- P95 increases >200ms sustained for 8m triggers auto-degen to q0
- error-rate delta >3% for 3m triggers immediate hold + paging
- cost anomaly: token-cost >+15% vs baseline for 10m will pause rollout for biz review
- add a rapid circuit-breaker: 3 failed health-checks in 90s -> immediate 0% for 5m

sam: A couple Qs: 1) are we using runtime reroute weighting or deploybot slot moves? prefer weighting to avoid slot churn. 2) need explicit telemetry hooks for token-cost metric (billing) not just latency/errors.

lee: Agreed on weighting. I'll add token-cost metric to the canary dashboard and set alert thresholds. Also suggest raising KV-ttl to 8h for 24h to minimize cold-miss noise.

ops-janet: From SRE side LGTM. Add: wire auto-created incident to #incidents and a dedicated ephemeral channel r-2026-442-maelstrom for ops coordination. On-call rota paged if circuit-breaker fires.

nina: Good call. Rollout ID: r-2026-442-maelstrom. We'll create ephemeral channel at rollout start.

doc-rolf: I'll prepare the release blurb and migration notes. Draft blurb: "maelstrom-14b-q1: improved long-context throughput and lower variance for streaming APIs. Soft-migration path provided via compat variant. See docs/catalog/maelstrom-14b-q1.md"

deploy-bot: dry-run OK:
```
$ catalogctl plan --enable maelstrom-14b-q1 --stages 0.5,3,15,60,100 --pin hard:2h,soft:4h --prewarm true --exclude ap-south
Plan simulated. No routing conflicts. Will generate rollout token r-2026-442-maelstrom.
```

sam: One more: enforce fallback constraint in runtime: zephyr-6b-v3 only used when request.tokens <=64 AND no q0 free capacity. Can runtime support that rule?

lee: Yes, runtime policy supports conditional fallbacks by token-length predicate. I'll add rule and update config repo.

ops-janet: Also request: small canary bump from 15->60 should be manual only after a green check and signoff from SRE + product. Add a gating checklist item in the deploy job.

nina: Will enforce manual hold and checklist in deploybot job. Prewarm scheduled to start at 2026-04-05T08:40:00Z; rollout start 2026-04-05T09:00:00Z.

deploy-bot: scheduling job: r-2026-442-maelstrom at 2026-04-05T09:00:00Z. Prewarm window: 2026-04-05T08:40:00Z.

doc-rolf: Release note posted to /releases and linked in docs PR. Migration snippet: `catalog.pin("maelstrom-14b-q1", variant="compat", type="soft", duration="4h")`

sam: acked 1: added token-cost hooks to the dashboard.

lee: acked 1: config PR opened with fallback predicate.

ops-janet: acked 1: incident wiring done, on-call notified.

nina: acked 1: deploybot job updated and pin commands ready. I'll be monitoring first two steps. :eyes: :rocket:

deploy-bot: canary step 1 (0.5%) started: 1764123500 1: hooks attached and metrics streaming.

nina: thanks team, post any anomalies here. If all green, we'll continue to 3% in 12m. (reacts: :thumbsup: :tada:)
